description: Prior approval under Class MA of Part 3, Schedule 2 of the GPDO for the change of use of the existing lower ground floor of the building from Class E (commercial) to class C3 (dwelling houses) to provide 3 x self contained residential units.
decision_conditions: <p>The dwelling(s) shall not be occupied until the external works approved under planning permission Ref. 2025/1427, which are required to safeguard the natural light to the habitable rooms, have been fully completed in accordance with the approved plans for that permission.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that an acceptable standard of residential amenity is provided for the future occupiers of the development, specifically in respect of natural light to habitable rooms, in accordance with Policy MA.2(f) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (or the relevant policy at the time of the decision).</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>All residential premises shall be designed in accordance with BS 8233:2014 'Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings’ to attain the following noise levels: Resting (Living room) 35 dB LAeq, 16hrs (Day), Dining (Dining room/area) 40 dB LAeq, 16hrs (Day), and Sleeping (Bedroom) 35 dB LAeq, 16hrs (Day) / 30 dB LAeq, 8hrs (Night). A test shall be carried out prior to the discharge of this condition to show that the required noise levels have been met and the results submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.</p><p>REASON: To obtain required sound insulation and prevent noise nuisance.</p>

<p>Prior to commencement of the development, a scheme of sound insulation measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council, of an enhanced sound insulation value Dnt,w [and L’nt,w] of at least 5dB above the standards of Building Regulations Approved Document E ‘Resistance to the passage of sound’ for the floor/ceiling/wall structures separating different types of rooms/uses in adjoining dwellings, namely [e.g. living room and kitchen above bedroom of separate dwelling]. Approved details shall be implemented prior to occupation of the development and thereafter be permanently retained.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site is not adversely affected by noise.</p>

<p>Section 7.7.3.4 of BS8233:2014 specifies the maximum recommended noise levels within living accommodations resulting from lift operation. The levels provided in that standard should not be exceeded at any point during the lift cycle. The lift motor and associated equipment should be installed on suitable anti-vibration mountings to prevent the transmission of excessive vibration and/or structure-borne noise to any parts of the living accommodation.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site is not adversely affected by noise.</p>

<p>Sound insulation shall be installed between the Office premises on the ground floor and residential premises. The applicant shall provide a scheme of sound insulation that shall be submitted for approval to the Council’s Noise Section prior to the commenced use of these residential units.</p><p>REASON: To obtain required sound insulation and prevent noise nuisance.</p>

<p>Any new plant shall be installed, together with any associated ancillary equipment, so as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into neighbouring premises. The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises. An assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019, and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval. The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>REASON: To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the relevant works, a policy compliant cycle parking plan,, which shows details of layout, foundation, stand type and spacing, of cycle parking spaces, shall submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority</p><p>REASON: To ensure that adequate provision for the safe and secure storage of bicycles is made for future occupiers and in the interest of safeguarding highway safety.</p>
